# access.CreateRoleInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Creates a custom role (core.role.create); unknown permissions answer 422 UNKNOWN_PERMISSION.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `access.CreateRoleInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.role.create` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | yes | `none` | What the role is for. |  |
| `name` | yes | `none` | Display name of the role. |  |
| `permissions` | yes | `none` | Tenant permissions to grant; each must be held by the caller (no escalation). |  |

_None._
